name: True First Person
description: F11 toggles the game's own first-person view, driven as the retail mod drives it: eye position, field of view, near clip, scope blur, weapon and arm placement with your imported placements, bob and sway, head hiding, sleeves and hand grips. Settings are in DBF-MCM; Page Up opens the placement editor (needs Goose Overlay Host). Switch the First Person Controller off: the two cannot run together.
